Today I started designing the SkyForge Mini FPV custom flight-controller PCB. I planned the placement of the ESP32, MPU6050, nRF24L01 and power-regulation sections. I also planned the connections to the 4-in-1 ESC and started arranging the PCB components. Next, I will complete the schematic and begin routing.
